general: PeoplePay360 AI Assistant provides verified self-service answers for employee attendance, leave balances, compensation summaries, team directories, and company HR policies.
credentials: This assistant never handles passwords, OTPs, or authentication credentials. Use PeoplePay360's secure login and profile settings page for credential updates.
probation: The standard probation period for new employees is 3 to 6 months depending on role seniority. A confirmation review is conducted by your manager prior to completion.
noticePeriod: Standard employee notice period is 60 calendar days (or 90 days for management roles). Early release is subject to manager approval and knowledge handover.
workModel: PeoplePay360 operates on a modern hybrid working policy: employees may work up to 2 days per week remotely with team alignment, with 3 days in-office collaboration.
codeOfConduct: Employees are expected to maintain professional conduct, respect workplace diversity, protect proprietary source code and customer data, and adhere to NDAs.
